title: Configuration fails loudly
description: Some configuration mistakes fail quietly: a process started without --config runs with defaults, a misspelt or empty role is accepted, and a malformed scanInterval is found only once the scan loop starts.
acceptanceCriteria: --roles=wokrer, --roles= and --roles=api,,stream exit non-zero naming the role
A malformed scanInterval stops every role before anything is written to Postgres
A process started without --config behaves as docs/running.md states, checked by a test (drain included)
notes: A misspelt, empty, repeated or 'all'-inside-a-list role is refused naming it; a bad scanInterval stops every role before Postgres; no --config is the same as {}.
